findings.issue: Debounce timer is never cleared, so a pending goto('/?q=…') can fire after the user navigates away from the home page (hijacking the route) or after clicking pagination (reverting page to 1).
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer on unmount via $effect(() => () => clearTimeout(debounce)) or beforeNavigate, and no-op in the callback if the component is no longer current.

findings.issue: Cache stores only settled responses with no in-flight dedup or invalidation: concurrent duplicate fetches, and stale data forever in a long-lived process.
findings.suggestion: Cache the fetch Promise instead of the result (deduplicates concurrent callers) and consider a simple TTL, since the spec treats the API as live.

findings.issue: spriteFor constructs a sprite URL when the API explicitly returned null for front_default, yielding broken images.
findings.suggestion: Return null and have PokemonCard render a placeholder instead of guessing a URL the API said doesn't exist.

findings.issue: speciesFromPokemonRefs' augment callback receives the caller's array index; the abilities load silently depends on refs being an unfiltered 1:1 mapping of its entries.
findings.suggestion: Pass the original entry (not an index) to augment, or document the invariant at the API boundary.

findings.issue: Home page load fans out to 48 per-pokemon requests per page view (first hit); type/ability/move pages fan out to hundreds via speciesFromPokemonRefs.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the concurrency limiter and cache, but consider batching or a longer-lived warm cache if cold-load latency matters.

findings.issue: Table body cells are hand-written while the header is driven by the columns array, so column definitions live in two places.
findings.suggestion: Render body cells from the same columns array (with a per-column renderer) to keep them in sync.

findings.issue: Method-ordering comparator is a dense one-liner mixing indexOf defaults and localeCompare.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small `methodRank(name)` helper for readability.

summary: A small, well-organized SvelteKit 3 app that follows current framework guidance to the letter — inline vite-plugin config, $app/state, goto({reset:false}), runes and snippets — with clean server/client boundaries and genuinely earned abstractions. The only real defect is an uncancelled debounce timer that can fire a stale goto after navigation; the rest is nits around cache dedup and a fabricated sprite fallback. I'd merge after one quick round addressing the timer race.
